title: How To Start a $10K/Month AI Automation Agency (No Code)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Flo is Lindy's owner and promotes its platform. The AI agency's revenue and pricing figures are second-hand and explicitly approximate.

stated_problem.quote: most people they either don't know how to set up these AI agents or even if they know they don't have the time to

idea.name: Lindy AI automation agency
idea.one_liner: Build and maintain AI agents for businesses, charging setup and ongoing maintenance fees.

idea.offer: Set up and maintain client AI agents, with free demos and templates to attract prospects.
idea.revenue_model: One-time setup fee plus recurring maintenance; the amounts reported are second-hand.

I don't want the template I want you to set it up for me

claims.quote: I forgot the exact number that he told me but I think it's starting to generate like $10,000 a month with his Lindy agency

claims.claim: The agency reportedly charges a one-time setup fee and $500 or $1,000 per month for maintenance; the setup amount is not stated.
claims.quote: I believe he's charging like a onetime setup fee and then like an ongoing maintenance fee of like $500 or $1,000 a month

claims.claim: The guest suggests three leads might make the service pay for itself.
claims.quote: pay for itself like three leads or something

acquisition_channels.details: The agency operator posts on LinkedIn and makes YouTube demos; some viewers ask for a done-for-you setup.

ideas.delivery: The founder configures AI agents for clients and provides ongoing maintenance.

prices: One-time setup fee; amount not stated

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to client and prospect data handled by agents. PECR applies to marketing automation: unsolicited email is limited to corporate subscribers with an opt-out; calls must be screened against TPS/CTPS where required.
